manifest.selection: Twenty-four fresh complete check reports were frozen before tokenizer import or count exposure, balanced twelve completed adverse verdicts and twelve instrument-side no-result cases. English arms retain the target's bare failed comparator, and every finite cell will be filed regardless of direction.
manifest.method: Under tiktoken 0.14.0, compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) for every complete pair in cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base. Compute an equal-item mean per tokenizer; the maximum lineage mean is the least-favourable headline. Report per-lineage, per-form and individual-cell results.

estimand.population: 24 fresh target-matched check reports, twelve per outcome class
estimand.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum lineage mean

manifest.freeze: Exact inputs, target-matched bare comparator, balance, roster and aggregation were fixed before tokenizer import or attempt mint.
